crossRefs.note: Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem: twelve cities with their villages.

parallels.note: When the children of Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and didn’t utterly drive them…

people.name: Canaan
people.line: Ancient region; descendants of Ham; promised to Abraham's descendants

people.name: Kitron
people.line: A city in Zebulun not conquered

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
translations.bsb: Zebulun failed to drive out the inhabitants of Kitron and Nahalol; so the Canaanites lived among them and served as forced laborers.
translations.kjv: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
translations.asv: Zebulun drove not out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became subject to taskwork.
